checked_files.finding: Normal map checks Energy >= campaign energyCost * sweepNum; insufficient Raid Tickets offer Crystal sweep only when sweepNum <= current Crystal.
Same source-native sweep Energy/ticket/Crystal gating as MapDetailWindow.
MID117 sends sweep_type and removes Raid Ticket 50001013 x sweep_num locally after successful ITEM_SWEEP; server must persist the debit.
ADD_ENERGY request payload is empty {}; success response supplies buy_energy_times.
All web MIDs except chat are retryable; failure prompt re-invokes webRequest_ with the same mid and params, so MID97's empty payload is replay-ambiguous.
ADD_ENERGY nth price uses buyEnergyCost(times+1); allowance uses VIP numEnergy plus active Monthly Privilege numEnergy; client checks energyMaxLimit.
Source nth stamina-purchase Crystal costs; ordinals begin 50,50,100,100,100,100,200,200,200,400...
num_energy is source daily purchase allowance (VIP0=1 through VIP15=16).
QA seed remains subject to source per-item stack ceilings; foods cap at 99, Raid Ticket at 9999, magic consumables at 999.

decisions: Do not alter MID114: runtime and backend evidence show its Energy debit already works.
MID117 live settlement must atomically persist source Energy plus the selected ticket/Crystal input and deterministic rewards.
Developer QA seed is source-stack-bounded and one-shot/non-replenishing.
Do not implement MID97 with invented retry semantics: empty request payload cannot distinguish lost-response replay from a legitimate next purchase.
